confidence_notes: Beer (0.5 L draught), coffee and restaurant anchors are medium confidence: 2026-dated Tallinn aggregator figures (Expatistan, travel-cost guides, nationwide Numbeo-style data) are broadly consistent, mostly within about 15 percent. Cocktail rests on one rough club-level estimate and 2026 citywide ranges, set at about 2x beer. Wine glass is low confidence: no restaurant glass price was found, so it is set at about 1.2x beer. Accommodation is a holistic July model estimate; no accommodation searches or listings were checked. EUR converted at an assumed 1.15 USD per EUR. FX is third-party attributed: the 2026-11-03 value comes from bestexchangerates.com citing the RBA; rba.gov.au was not read and no later observation was found, so verify before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used for food and drink, which rests on Tallinn-specific aggregator figures. Accommodation uses a general Baltic-capital peak-season judgment rather than a named comparable city.
